topPRs.title: fix: opus 4.x temperature=1, output cap, ai-sdk v6 maxOutputTokens rename
topPRs.author: NubsCarson
topPRs.body:
two real bugs preventing opus 4.x from working through this plugin at all: ### 1. ai-sdk v6 renamed `maxTokens` → `maxOutputTokens` the plugin still passed `maxTokens:` to `streamText`/`generateText`. ai-sdk v6 silently ignores the old name and falls back to `maxOutputTokensForModel` from `getModelCapabilities`, which for `claude-opus-4-6` is hardcoded to **128k**. opus's actual output cap is **32k**, so every request returned `400 invalid_request_error: Invalid request data`. ### 2. opus 4.x rejects any `temperature ≠ 1` extended-thinking-capable models require `temperature: 1`. with the previous default of 0.7, the api returned the same `400 invalid_request_error` even after the maxTokens fix. confirmed by bisecting fields against the live api with my own claude max OAuth token. ### what this PR does in `resolveTextParams`: - if the model name contains \`opus\` and temperature is not 1, force it to 1 - cap the resolved `maxTokens` at the model's actual output limit (32k for opus 4.x, 64k for everything newer; the existing claude-3 default of 4096 is preserved untouched via Math.min) in `generateTextWithModel`: - rename the field passed to ai-sdk from \`maxTokens\` to \`maxOutputTokens\` so it's actually respected ### verification - before: every call to \`useModel(TEXT_LARGE)\` with \`claude-opus-4-6\` returned 400. confirmed via wire-level interceptor logging the request body. - after: same call returns a clean 200, opus-generated response. verified with the request body \`max_tokens: 8192, temperature: 1\` reaching api.anthropic.com. - bisected against live api with curl using the exact body the plugin generates pre- and post-fix. - chat layer + spawned task agents both running on opus 4.6 in production for ~24h after this fix landed downstream. ### notes - minimal: 2 commits, ~13 lines added across one file (`typescript/models/text.ts`), no new types, no new params, no new exports. - inlined the single-use \`requestedMaxTokens\` local in a follow-up commit per repo style. - doesn't touch \`models/object.ts\` or \`models/image.ts\` — those flow through different code paths and don't show the same symptom in practice, but worth a follow-up if anyone wants belt-and-suspenders. ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **Chores** * Updated @elizaos/core dependency to version 2.0.0-alpha.115 * Bumped package version to 2.0.0-alpha.13 * Updated module resolution paths in TypeScript build configuration * **Refactor** * Enhanced text generation handling with improved caching support and token limit management for Anthropic models * Refined temperature and output parameter handling

Greptile Summary

This PR fixes two legitimate 400-error bugs in the Anthropic plugin's text model path: renaming `maxTokens` → `maxOutputTokens` for AI SDK v6 compatibility, and enforcing `temperature=1` for opus 4.x models. However, the model-matching predicate `modelName.includes("opus")` is broader than intended: - **`claude-3-opus-20240229` is also matched**, silently overriding any caller-supplied temperature to `1` even though that model has no such requirement — a behavioral regression for users of the older model. - The temperature enforcement is also skipped when only `topP` is supplied (no `temperature`), leaving a gap for the case it was meant to fix.

Confidence Score: 4/5

Safe to merge after tightening the opus model-match predicate to exclude claude-3-opus. The two core fixes (maxOutputTokens rename, temperature enforcement) are correct and well-motivated. Score is 4 rather than 5 because of one P1 finding: the includes("opus") predicate silently overrides temperature for claude-3-opus-20240229, which is a behavioral regression for any user on that model. The topP gap is a P2 edge case that does not block merge on its own. typescript/models/text.ts — specifically the modelName.includes("opus") guard at lines 157 and 167.

Vulnerabilities

 No security concerns identified. Changes are limited to model parameter resolution logic (temperature clamping, token cap, field rename) with no auth, input validation, or data-exposure implications.

Important Files Changed

| Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | typescript/models/text.ts | Core fix file: renames maxTokens→maxOutputTokens for AI SDK v6, adds opus output cap, and enforces temperature=1 for opus — but the model match pattern (includes("opus")) also affects claude-3-opus unintentionally, and the temperature guard is skipped when only topP is provided. | | typescript/package.json | Dependency versions unchanged; confirms ai@^6.0.23 is already in use, validating the maxOutputTokens rename. | | package.json | Root package.json unchanged in substance; no issues. | | typescript/tsconfig.json | TypeScript config unchanged; no issues. | | typescript/tsconfig.build.json | Build tsconfig unchanged; no issues. |

Flowchart

```mermaid %%{init: {'theme': 'neutral'}}%% flowchart TD A[resolveTextParams called] --> B{hasTopP && hasTemperature?} B -- yes --> C[use temperature, drop topP] B -- no --> D{hasTopP only?} D -- yes --> E[temperature = undefined topP = param.topP] D -- no --> F[temperature = param.temperature ?? 0.7 topP = undefined] C --> G{modelName.includes opus?} E --> G F --> G G -- yes, temperature != undefined AND != 1 --> H[force temperature = 1] G -- no / guard fails --> I[temperature unchanged] H --> J[maxTokens = Math.min param.maxTokens ?? default, opus ? 32k : 64k] I --> J J --> K[generateParams built maxOutputTokens: resolved.maxTokens temperature: resolved.temperature] K --> L{params.stream?} L -- yes --> M[streamText generateParams] L -- no --> N[generateText generateParams] style E fill:#f9c,stroke:#c66 style G fill:#fc9,stroke:#c90 ```

Comments Outside Diff (1)

 1. `typescript/models/text.ts`, line 147-159 ([link](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/blob/3be00ea04d535f9fd48dba3cc847caa2c32ed565/typescript/models/text.ts#L147-L159)) **Temperature=1 enforcement bypassed when only `topP` is supplied** When a caller provides `topP` but not `temperature` (line 148-149), `temperature` is set to `undefined`. The guard at line 157 (`temperature !== undefined`) then skips the enforcement entirely, sending no temperature value for an opus 4.x model. If Anthropic's server-side default for opus 4.x is not `1`, this path still produces a 400. Consider always enforcing `temperature = 1` for opus 4.x regardless of whether `temperature` was explicitly provided:
Reviews (1): Last reviewed commit: ["inline single-use maxTokens local"](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/commit/3be00ea04d535f9fd48dba3cc847caa2c32ed565) | [Re-trigger Greptile](https://app.greptile.com/api/retrigger?id=27773791) > Greptile also left **1 inline comment** on this PR.

topPRs.title: fix: cast emitEvent payload for EventPayloadMap compat
topPRs.author: dutchiono
topPRs.body:
## Summary - `MODEL_USED` is no longer in `EventPayloadMap`'s known keys after the `@elizaos/core` alpha.115 update - Cast the payload to `EventPayload` to use the generic overload and fix `TS2769` ## Test plan - [ ] TypeScript type check passes (`bunx tsc --noEmit`) 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) ## Summary by CodeRabbit ## Release Notes * **Refactor** * Improved type safety for event emission handling.

Greptile Summary

This is a minimal, type-only fix to resolve `TS2769` caused by `EventType.MODEL_USED` being dropped from `EventPayloadMap`'s known keys in `@elizaos/core` alpha.115. Adding `as EventPayload` selects the generic `emitEvent` overload at compile time with no change to runtime behavior.

Confidence Score: 5/5

Safe to merge — type-only change with no runtime impact. Single-line type assertion fix targeting a known upstream breaking change in @elizaos/core alpha.115. No logic, data flow, or runtime behavior is altered; the only effect is resolving TS2769 at compile time. No files require special attention.

Vulnerabilities

 No security concerns identified.

Important Files Changed

| Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | typescript/utils/events.ts | Imports `EventPayload` and casts the `emitEvent` payload `as EventPayload` to resolve TS2769 after `MODEL_USED` was removed from `EventPayloadMap` in @elizaos/core alpha.115; no runtime logic changes. |

Sequence Diagram

```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Model as models/text.ts (image.ts, object.ts) participant Events as utils/events.ts participant Runtime as IAgentRuntime Model->>Events: emitModelUsageEvent(runtime, type, prompt, usage) Events->>Events: compute promptTokens, completionTokens, totalTokens Events->>Runtime: emitEvent(EventType.MODEL_USED, payload as EventPayload) Note over Events,Runtime: Cast to EventPayload selects generic overload (TS2769 fix) ``` Reviews (1): Last reviewed commit: ["fix: cast emitEvent payload for @elizaos..."](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-anthropic/commit/6711acc78e013c3ae6f7d0afc1dde9d165e4363d) | [Re-trigger Greptile](https://app.greptile.com/api/retrigger?id=27879681)
